name: tags_assign
description: Assign custom tags and/or a review status (Needs review / In progress / Approved / Rejected) to creations AND Spaces. Statuses are mutually exclusive — assigning one replaces another. Batch, idempotent, max 10 custom tags/item. Names or ids from tags_list; assets from creations_search, Spaces from spaces_list (`creationIdentifier` or Space `id` UUID + that row's `projectReference`). When tagging many Spaces, group by projectReference and call once per group — do not ask for names/links when projectReference is present. Never auto-creates. Do not call statuses "tags". Never tell the user Spaces cannot be tagged.

creationIdentifiers.description: Asset creation sqids from creations_search, OR Space creationIdentifier / Space id UUID from spaces_list (same projectReference as that row).

projectReference.description: Project/folder ref from folders_list, or projectReference from spaces_list for Spaces.

tags.description: Custom tag and/or review status names (preferred) or numeric ids as strings. Status names come from tags_list.statuses.
